newsitem.title: SWEDEN: NAGLIS SAYS RKB, ZEMES TO LIST ON BOURSE.
newsitem.headline: NAGLIS SAYS RKB, ZEMES TO LIST ON BOURSE.

text.p: The head of the Latvian privatisation agency, Janis Naglis, on Wednesday said that two banks, Rigas kommercbanka (RKB) and Zemes Banka, were planning to list their shares on the stock exchange.
RKB has said for some time that it wants a bourse listing whereas Zemes has so far not revealed any intentions to move to the stock exchange.
"Rigas kommercbanka is going for a listing and Zemes Banka as well," Naglis told Reuters at a conference on investing in the Baltic capital markets in the Swedish capital.
He made no further comments on the two banks' intentions.
Rietumu Banka has also said it would like to list its shares on the bourse, which currently only has one bank, Unibanka, listed.
